# RDA DMP Common Standard v1.3

`RDA-DMP-Common-Standard_v1.3.json` is an unmodified copy of
`examples/JSON/JSON-schema/1.3/maDMP-schema-1.3.json` from
https://github.com/RDA-DMP-Common/RDA-DMP-Common-Standard at commit
`76452a5442d6205853132addf4767b5355d2fba0` (30 Sep 2026), the newest version
in the repository. JSON Schema draft 2020-12.

Used only by tests, to validate what `mapFormToRda` exports.
